Oddly enough, '''refried beans''' ''(frijoles refritos)'' are only [[Cookbook:Frying|fried]] once. The prefix "re" is a [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Spain|Spanish]] prefix meaning "very" or "well", inappropriately tacked onto a non-Spanish word.

==Ingredients==
* [[Cookbook:Pinto Bean|Pinto beans]] or [[Cookbook:Black Bean|black beans]]
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]] (optional) or home-[[Cookbook:Rendering|rendered]] [[Cookbook:Lard|lard]] (optional)

==Procedure==
#If using dried beans, wash them then cover with water in a medium pot and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] according to the package directions. You may add [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]] halves or a [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]] bone, which you can remove at the end.[[Image:BeansHamPot.jpg|thumb|339x339px|Cooked [[Cookbook:Bean|Beans]] and [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]] bone]]
#If using canned beans, rinse them briefly before use.
#Smash the beans, perhaps with a potato [[Cookbook:Potato Masher|masher]].
#Add home-rendered lard or butter, totaling up to 20% of the total (25% of the amount prior to adding). You may also use a substantially smaller amount of some other oil or omit it entirely.
#Fry the beans, stirring and turning them until they thicken to the degree you desire, which can be anywhere from soupy to parched.

==Use==
*[[Cookbook:Burrito|Burrito]]
*[[Cookbook:Pupusa|Pupusa]]
